name: Video Super Resolution (prototype)
author: Echo-Storm
description: A prototype. Off until you switch it on. Upscales with NVIDIA's RTX Video Super Resolution in place of Lossless Scaling's NIS scaler: a trained network that sharpens the picture one frame at a time, which suits still scenes, menus, interface text and video. It runs on NVIDIA's Video Effects SDK (x64, Video Super Resolution feature): the files it needs are in this test package, in its vfx folder (a download option comes later); a different SDK folder can be set in its panel. Choose NIS as the Scaling Type and run the game in a window smaller than the screen. Only one upscaler works at a time.
